pages.title: Music Tiles: Fluffy Hop Beat
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Guide a fluffy character across a musical path in Music Tiles: Fluffy Hop Beat. The character advances automatically, leaving you to steer left and right so each hop lands on a tile in time with the beat. Use the mouse on a computer or swipe across a touchscreen to change direction. Complete levels and collect points while keeping the character on the tile route.

pages.title: Stick: Tactics & Destruction
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Fight monsters with a limited supply of ammunition in Stick: Tactics & Destruction. Bullets and grenades need careful use, with explosives also letting you break through structures to reach an enemy. Destruction can affect your escape route, so consider what a blast will remove before using it. Completing a level with little or no damage helps earn its highest, three-star rating.

pages.title: Find the Vampire
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Identify disguised bloodsuckers in Find the Vampire. You play a hunter trying to stop a vampire uprising and free the city from its attackers. Discover and destroy the hidden vampires, protect the citizens, and work toward defeating the Vampire Lord. The three-dimensional game centers on recognizing the threat concealed among the people you encounter.

pages.title: Kiss O Neck
pages.creator: Eyestorm Pte. LTD.
pages.description: Reach the correct kissing target by extending a character's neck in Kiss O Neck. Each level presents a different comic situation built around this stretching action. Your task is to direct the unusual reach toward the intended target and see how the scene unfolds.

pages.title: Grill Party
pages.creator: Bravestars Games
pages.description: Arrange matching barbecue skewers to fill orders in Grill Party. Swap and line up three identical skewers containing meats, seafood, or vegetables, clearing room on the grill for the next move. Levels limit both time and space, making the arrangement of the food part of the challenge. Boosters can remove obstacles when the grill becomes difficult to organize.

pages.title: Dragon Egg
pages.creator: ovokit
pages.description: Move and combine dragon eggs in Dragon Egg. Form qualifying groups of three or more to produce higher-level eggs, then continue combining them through further stages until new dragons hatch. The game uses five egg colors with multiple levels of merging. Use the mouse or a finger to select eggs on the board and move them into position for a combination.

pages.title: Hit Knock Down
pages.creator: Online Games
pages.description: Throw baseballs at varied targets in Hit Knock Down. Each level changes what you need to hit, with target materials including wood and stone. Use mouse clicks or taps to handle the throwing challenge and aim at the required objects.

pages.title: 1945 Air Force Airplane
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Take an airplane into aerial shooting battles in 1945 Air Force Airplane. Defeat enemies and upgrade your own plane as you work toward further victories. Use mouse clicks or taps to play.

pages.title: Code Maze
pages.creator: Rising Pixel
pages.description: Build an instruction sequence to cross each maze in Code Maze. Drag code blocks into place, using movement commands, loops, and conditionals to guide the avatar around obstacles and toward the goal. Test your sequence and retry when it needs changing. Using fewer blocks earns a higher score, rewarding a compact solution as well as a successful route.

pages.title: Basket Shot
pages.creator: GM - Good Media
pages.description: Shoot basketballs into hoops in Basket Shot. Use the drag controls to handle your attempts at making a basket. New balls can be unlocked as you play.

pages.title: Pursuit Rampage
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Drive a police car through an endless chase in Pursuit Rampage. Pursue criminals along busy streets, steering around traffic and obstacles while trying to keep up with the pursuit. Use WASD or the arrow keys to drive, H to sound the horn, and C to change the camera.

pages.title: Griddlers Deluxe
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Reveal pictures by solving number clues in Griddlers Deluxe. The numbers beside each row and column describe groups of squares to fill. When a line has several numbers, its filled groups must have at least one empty square between them. Compare the clues across both directions to work out which squares belong in the hidden image. The game offers nearly 200 puzzles to solve.

pages.title: Nugget Man Survival Puzzle
pages.creator: Meyagames
pages.description: Help a balloon-supported character escape the desert in Nugget Man Survival Puzzle. Solve the route's puzzles and reach the finish before time expires, keeping the balloons from bursting along the way. Desert bandits, cacti, and other obstacles threaten the rescue. Use mouse clicks or taps to play while Gedagedago music accompanies the journey.

pages.title: Save My Pet Party
pages.creator: gameVgames
pages.description:
Draw barriers to protect animals from bees in Save My Pet Party. The bees arrive from different positions in each level, so shape the protection around the current layout. Hints and level skips are available for difficult puzzles.

Play alone with the mouse and left button, or choose two-player mode. The first player's drawing controls use WASD and E, while the second player's use the arrow keys and L.

pages.title: Military Cubes 2048
pages.creator: IT-Hype
pages.description: Throw numbered blocks together in Military Cubes 2048. Two cubes with an equal value merge into one worth twice as much, so a pair of twos produces a four. Different values remain separate and begin filling the play area, where overcrowding can lead to a loss. Use the cubes' physical movement to set up merges, work toward 2048, and raise your score.

pages.title: Spaces Solitaire
pages.creator: bestphysics
pages.description: Reorganize cards into ascending rows of one suit in Spaces Solitaire. Select a card and move it into an empty gap, following a card of the same suit that is exactly one rank lower. An ace can start a row. Each move creates another gap where the selected card used to be, changing which moves are available as you put the rows into order.

pages.title: ASMR Stye Treatment
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Guide a patient through a virtual care session in ASMR Stye Treatment. Use the mouse to carry out the game's treatment activities for her facial blemishes and stye, then move on to a makeover. Choose makeup and an outfit from the available collections to complete her new look.

pages.title: KrisMas Mahjong 2
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Connect pairs of seasonal tiles in KrisMas Mahjong 2. Select identical items that can be joined by a valid connecting line, clearing the board before the timer expires. Choose the classic game or a relaxed mode with a larger grid and more repeated tiles. An advent calendar offers daily connect puzzles, while completed levels let you open a fortune cookie for a holiday message.

pages.title: Pinball Brick Mania
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Pinball Brick Mania combines ball shots with block clearance. Aim at the '+' targets to increase your supply of balls, then use the growing collection to break blocks and build your score.

pages.title: Hexotopia
pages.creator: AA2G1
pages.description: Assemble a landscape from hexagonal tiles in Hexotopia. Drag a hex onto the board and release it in position, clicking the tile when you want to rotate it. The urban-planning puzzle centers on arranging these pieces into a landscape. WASD moves the camera, and the mouse wheel changes the zoom so you can inspect the board while choosing placements.

pages.title: Parking Training
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description:
Practice maneuvering into spaces in Parking Training. Complete parking levels involving tasks such as reversing and parallel parking, following signs and street markings while avoiding nearby vehicles and objects. Three collisions end the attempt and require a restart.

Use the arrow keys to drive and follow the guide arrow to collect money along the route. The money can be used for another car or upgrades, giving you more to work toward as you complete the parking exercises.

pages.title: 45 Challenges Block Collapse
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Collect the block groups requested by each level in 45 Challenges Block Collapse. Select groups with the mouse or touchpad, working toward the current challenge within its turn allowance. Some tasks require collecting several groups of a specified size. Finishing with fewer turns earns bonus points. Complete all 45 levels to finish the sequence of challenges.

pages.title: Magic Circus - Match 3
pages.creator: AnimaGames
pages.description: Swap crystals to solve circus-themed boards in Magic Circus - Match 3. Form a row of three identical crystals to collect them, then clear the obstacles required by the level's goals. Bonuses and combinations provide effects that help with the arrangements ahead. The game offers unlimited lives, allowing further attempts as you work through its crystal-matching challenges.

pages.title: Santa's Delivery
pages.creator: Misc.261 Games
pages.description: Help Santa arrange presents by the Christmas trees in Santa's Delivery. Move him through the puzzle so every gift reaches its destination, then guide him to the chimney to finish the stage and continue to the next challenge. Use WASD or the arrow keys, or swipe up, down, left, and right with mouse or touch controls.

pages.title: Real Football Challenge
pages.creator: Gameloft SE
pages.description: Work out a route to goal in Real Football Challenge. The game presents tactical football puzzles involving passes, shots, teammates, and opposing players. Study each setup and guide the ball through the scoring opportunity, following the on-screen instructions for the current situation. Progress through the challenges as you lead the team toward the championship.

pages.title: Dino Grass Island
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Explore grassy islands as an animal trainer in Dino Grass Island. Slide to move, cutting grass and opening bushes to uncover eggs. Collect the eggs and work toward taming the animals you discover. Each island also has a boss to defeat before you can travel to the next one.

pages.title: State.io - Conquer the World
pages.creator: CASUAL AZUR GAMES
pages.description: Compete for territory in State.io - Conquer the World. Attack enemy lands and towers while defending your own borders, working across different maps to gain control of the contested regions. Early levels pit you against one opponent, while later stages introduce more competing forces. The real-time strategy challenge combines expansion with keeping your existing territory protected.

pages.title: Epic Hole Runner
pages.creator: Brosco Games
pages.description: Grow a moving hole by swallowing objects in Epic Hole Runner. Absorbing items earns points and increases its size, while uninterrupted collecting starts a multiplier. Avoid red barrels that explode and shrink the hole. Green barrels trigger a rush mode that gives you maximum size and invulnerability. Complete quests to unlock skins as you work through the object-consuming runs.

pages.title: Bazooka Boy Online
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Demolish enemy positions in Bazooka Boy Online. Aim and fire a selection of weapons to eliminate opponents, blow apart bases, and bring down buildings. Different weapons have their own properties to explore, with ragdoll reactions and explosions accompanying the destruction. Clear the enemies to finish a level, using mouse or touchscreen controls to aim and shoot.

pages.title: Eliatopia
pages.creator: Scherer Designs
pages.description:
Explore an alien planet as a human visitor from Earth in Eliatopia. Travel with friends, fight monsters, and develop your character through weapons, armor, skills, and ability points. Certain areas also allow combat against other players. The setting's story includes mysteries involving the planet's government and its connections to Earth.

Move with WASD or the arrow keys, aim with the mouse, and press C to attack. E picks up items as you explore and equip the character.

pages.title: Boller
pages.creator: PKPL Entertainment
pages.description: Aim the ball at numbered bricks in Boller. Each brick's number shows how many hits it needs before disappearing. Click and drag from the ball to choose a firing direction, then try to remove the approaching blocks before they reach the bottom of the screen and end the attempt.

pages.title: Tanks PVP Showdown
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Trade tank shots with an opponent in Tanks PVP Showdown. Choose a weapon, tap and drag to set its shooting angle, then select Fire to launch the attack. Destroy the opposing tank while using the available weapons to deal damage. Coins can unlock additional tanks, and emoji reactions let you communicate during the showdown.

pages.title: Crypto Ninja
pages.creator: Rich Games
pages.description: Slice flying crypto tokens while avoiding bombs in Crypto Ninja. Drag through the targets to cut them and build your score, keeping the slicing trail away from the explosives mixed into the action. The cryptocurrency theme changes the targets in this swipe-based arcade challenge.

pages.title: Effing Worms Xmas
pages.creator: Effing Games Inc.
pages.description: Burrow beneath the ground and burst onto the surface to feed in Effing Worms Xmas. Play a hungry worm hunting elves, yeti, and reindeer after receiving an unwanted Christmas present from Santa. Move with WASD or the arrow keys, directing the creature between its underground route and the creatures above it.

pages.title: Free Gear
pages.creator: David Jalbert
pages.description: Race toward a world championship in Free Gear. Compete against seven other drivers across five tournaments, with 20 races set in different environments and weather conditions. The arrow keys control your car, Z and X handle gear changes, and C activates nitro. Work through the tournaments while managing both your driving and the car's gear shifts.

pages.title: Ski King 2022
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Ski downhill while an avalanche threatens your escape in Ski King 2022. Avoid obstacles, follow the route's arrows, and gather coins along the slope. Spend the coins on skill upgrades that change how your skier handles the run. A boost button provides acceleration, adding another option as you try to keep moving ahead of the avalanche.

pages.title: Target Hit 3D
pages.creator: Ohayō
pages.description: Throw knives past obstacles to reach the target in Target Hit 3D. Left-click to launch a knife, judging when the route is clear so the shot reaches its mark. Enough successful hits clear the level. Collect coins during play and use the store to buy additional weapons for later attempts.

pages.title: Find Different Pic Halloween
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Pick the odd image out in Find Different Pic Halloween. Each challenge displays four Halloween pictures: three match, while one has a change for you to spot. Compare the details and select the different picture with the mouse or touch pad. There are 40 challenges to complete, each asking you to identify the single image that differs.

pages.title: Halloween Words Search
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Find the listed seasonal words in Halloween Words Search. Look for each word in a straight line through the letter blocks, searching horizontally, vertically, or diagonally in any direction. The left panel shows what remains to be found. Use the mouse or touch pad to select words, and locate the whole list to complete the level.

pages.title: NextRealm Bubbles
pages.creator: Next Realm Games
pages.description: Grow by consuming food and smaller opponents in NextRealm Bubbles. This open-world multiplayer game challenges you to become the largest bubble, choosing targets that are small enough to eat. Click to boost when you want a burst of speed, but the move spends some of your mass and temporarily leaves you vulnerable. Decide whether the extra speed is worth that loss of size.

pages.title: Shortcut Run 3D
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Build a quicker route to the finish in Shortcut Run 3D. Use planks to make shortcuts during the race, changing the path you take toward the endpoint. Drag to control the runner and line up the route you want to follow.

pages.title: Blocks Puzzle Halloween
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Fit monster-themed pieces into empty board spaces in Blocks Puzzle Halloween. Drag and drop the blocks to complete full lines, clearing tiles and earning points when a row disappears. Clearing at least two rows with one placement awards a combo bonus. Compare each piece with the gaps on the board before choosing where to put it.

pages.title: Blockcraft Truck Jigsaw
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Rebuild block-style truck pictures in Blockcraft Truck Jigsaw. Choose one of six images, then select Easy with 25 pieces, Medium with 49, or Hard with 100. Use the mouse or touchscreen to place the fragments in their correct positions. The three piece counts let you change the complexity of the picture you choose to assemble.

pages.title: Classic Mahjong
pages.creator: Restaurant Games
pages.description: Clear a layered tile layout by removing matching pairs in Classic Mahjong. Choose a board and select pairs from the tiles available for removal, opening more of the layout as you clear them. The game displays the tiles remaining and elapsed time while you work. Remove every pair to finish the board.

pages.title: Egg Shooter Bubble Dinosaur
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Clear a field of colored eggs in Egg Shooter Bubble Dinosaur. Tap and drag to adjust the firing direction, then release to send the next egg into the group. Connecting at least three eggs of one color breaks them. Try to remove all the eggs with as few shots as possible, choosing matches that make each shot count.

pages.title: Hill Race Adventure
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Choose from three cars and drive through 21 levels in Hill Race Adventure. Upgrade the vehicles as you continue through the driving stages. Use the arrow keys or tap controls to handle your chosen car.

pages.title: Jumpy Car
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Keep a car on the platforms in Jumpy Car. Tap the screen to make the vehicle jump, timing each leap so it lands on another platform instead of dropping off. Continue driving across the platforms by judging the next gap and choosing when to jump.

pages.title: Zombie Smash : Monster Truck Racing Game
pages.creator: wingmangames
pages.description: Drive a monster truck through an arena overrun by zombies in Zombie Smash : Monster Truck Racing Game. Use the keyboard arrows to steer and crush the creatures with the truck. The objective is to eliminate zombies while surviving, making the vehicle itself your means of fighting through the apocalyptic arena.

pages.title: Beat Em Up Street fight 2D
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Take on street opponents in Beat Em Up Street fight 2D. Move with the arrow keys and use Z to punch or X to kick. C defends against an attack, while Space makes your fighter jump. Combine movement with those combat actions as you confront the enemies in the street.

pages.title: Scary Frankenstein Difference
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Compare two Frankenstein-themed pictures in Scary Frankenstein Difference. Click or tap the details that do not match, finding all seven differences before the one-minute timer expires. Each correct selection marks a difference in the pictures and adds to the found total. Completing the set lets you continue to another scene.

pages.title: Boy Biggest Gum
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Control a growing bubble in Boy Biggest Gum. Press and hold to inflate the gum, then release before it touches the nails and bursts. Control its size by choosing when to stop inflating near the sharp obstacles. Use the mouse or touchscreen to handle the hold-and-release action through the levels.

pages.title: Arkadium's Word Wipe
pages.creator: Arkadium
pages.description: Turn connected letters into words in Arkadium's Word Wipe. Link letters to make words, remove them from the arrangement, and work toward clearing more rows. Forming additional words increases your score, while the game becomes faster and more demanding as you progress. Look across the remaining letters for your next word.

pages.title: City Police Bike Simulator
pages.creator: gamesfog
pages.description: Take a police motorcycle through city assignments in City Police Bike Simulator. Complete missions to earn cash and use nitro when you want a burst of speed. WASD or the arrow keys handle acceleration, braking, and steering. Left Shift activates the nitro boost, and Space applies the handbrake as you maneuver the bike through the city.

pages.title: Prison Box
pages.creator: FTG
pages.description: Keep a ball trapped inside its cage in Prison Box. When it approaches the opening at the bottom, click or tap to close the exit before it escapes. Watch its movement around the box and time the next closure when it returns. Your goal is to keep the ball enclosed for as long as possible.

pages.title: Happy Womens Day Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Build six celebration pictures in Happy Womens Day Puzzle. Choose a Women's Day image, then decide how many pieces to assemble: 16, 36, 64, or 100. Use the mouse to put the sections together until the picture is complete. Each of the six images offers the same four piece-count settings.

pages.title: Dress Up Wheel
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Try a mix of chance and fashion choices in Dress Up Wheel. Use the mouse to spin the wheel and make clothing selections for Mira. The wheel introduces a random element to the dress-up activity, while the clothing options let you put together her look.

pages.title: Santa Claus Puzzle Time
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Assemble Santa pictures at your own pace in Santa Claus Puzzle Time. Pick an image and fit its jigsaw pieces together to complete the scene and enter another level. There is no time limit, so you can concentrate on the picture without a countdown. Play with the mouse or tap controls.

pages.title: Christmas Stockings Memory
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Find matching picture pairs in Christmas Stockings Memory. Click or tap the tiles to reveal them, remembering what you uncover so you can select matching images. Pair every tile to finish the board. The game has four levels and challenges you to complete the matches in as few moves as possible.

pages.title: Xmas Illustration Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Piece together Christmas artwork in Xmas Illustration Puzzle. Six images are available, each with four puzzle sizes ranging from 16 pieces through 36 and 64 to 100. Use the mouse to assemble the scattered pieces into the full illustration. A higher piece count gives you smaller sections of the same chosen picture to arrange.

pages.title: Christmas Coloring Book
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Choose a festive picture and add your own colors in Christmas Coloring Book. Use the mouse to select colors and apply them to the image, deciding how you want the Christmas scene to look.

pages.title: DinoZ
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description:
Rescue scientists from escaped dinosaurs in DinoZ. The dinosaurs have taken hostages into a forest and placed traps along the way. Attempt the rescue alone or choose the two-player mode to tackle it with a friend.

Player one moves with WASD, attacks with F, uses H for bombs, and switches weapons with Q. Player two uses the arrows, L to attack, J for bombs, and U to change weapons. W and Up also handle jumping and wall jumps for the respective characters.

pages.title: Hyper Sliding Christmas Party
pages.creator: Polygon Game Studio
pages.description: Restore shuffled Christmas pictures in Hyper Sliding Christmas Party. Choose an image and a 3×3, 4×4, or 5×5 grid. One square is left empty, letting neighboring sections slide into that space. Move the pieces around the gap until every section returns to its correct position and the full picture is restored.

pages.title: Way of the Samurai
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Help a stranded samurai escape a deep hole in Way of the Samurai. Jump from one wall to the other to get past the dangerous obstacles blocking his climb. Use mouse or tap controls to choose when to cross between the sides as you try to guide him out.

pages.title: CDrone Survival
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Fight hostile robots in space with a drone in CDrone Survival. Attack the enemies while reacting to their attacks, trying to deal with the robots without letting their assault overwhelm you. Mouse or touch controls handle the action as you continue the drone's fight for survival.

pages.title: Blasty Bottles
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Knock bottles from their positions with a ball in Blasty Bottles. Press and hold to aim, then release to take the shot. The bottles are arranged in different places, so choose a trajectory that will hit the targets you need to bring down.

pages.title: Chroma Manga Girls
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Spread one color across the entire board in Chroma Manga Girls. Change the main square's color to absorb surrounding squares of that shade, gradually expanding the connected area. A level is complete when every square shares one color, revealing the hidden manga character. Choose colors according to the neighboring sections you want to bring into the growing region.

pages.title: Mini Jam Runner
pages.creator: Plug in Digital
pages.description: Rescue scattered chicks and grow a running flock in Mini Jam Runner. Use the one-button controls to jump through the route, avoiding hazards while finding more chicks to join you. Fury mode makes the flock invincible during its activation. You can also unlock different appearances for the chicks, including car, skull, and unicorn skins.

pages.title: Travelling Kids Memory
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Turn over illustrated tiles and find matching pairs in Travelling Kids Memory. Click with the mouse or tap a square to reveal its picture, then use what you have seen to locate its partner. Pair every tile to clear the board. The game has four levels, with completing the search in fewer moves giving you another goal to work toward.

pages.title: Color Hit
pages.creator: GAMEE
pages.description: Time colored-arrow shots at a rotating target in Color Hit. Tap to fire when the section matching your arrow's color is in its path. Arrows already attached to the target can block a later shot, so watch their positions as the circle turns. Keep matching colors while avoiding a collision that ends the attempt.

pages.title: Air Stunts Flying Simulator
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Combine flying and parachuting in Air Stunts Flying Simulator. Pilot the plane toward the destination, then descend in freefall and open the parachute in time to steer toward a giant landing target. WASD or the arrow keys control the aircraft, and Space applies its air brake. Use the mouse to accelerate the plane and open the parachute during the aerial challenge.

pages.title: Car Transport Truck Simulator
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Deliver cars between cities in Car Transport Truck Simulator. Take control of a transporter loaded with luxury vehicles and drive through traffic to complete the transport routes. Use WASD to steer the truck across the different levels.

pages.title: Galaxy Warriors
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Fight alien formations from your starship in Galaxy Warriors. Clear each wave while dodging the enemy fleet's return fire, then take on the bosses waiting among the attacks. Defeated enemies can drop credits and boosters. Spend the credits on ship upgrades and use the available boosts to help handle denser groups of enemies and their bullets.

pages.title: Tetris Game Boy
pages.creator: Yupi.io
pages.description: Arrange falling blocks into complete rows in Tetris Game Boy. Move and rotate each shape to fit it among the blocks already on the board, clearing filled horizontal lines to make room for more pieces. The game tracks both your score and the number of lines removed. Use the arrow or touch controls to handle the falling shapes.

pages.title: Pizzeria
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Navigate rooms of platforms and pizza ingredients in Pizzeria. Use the arrow keys to guide the action, collecting slices and toppings while keeping clear of saws and other hazards. Some boards can fall away, adding another obstacle to the route. The stages display score and time as you work through the ingredient-collecting challenge.

pages.title: High School Cheerleader Dressup
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Put together a cheerleading outfit in High School Cheerleader Dressup. Choose a girl and browse the clothing categories to combine dresses or separate tops and bottoms with socks and shoes. Change the hairstyle and select pom-poms to complete the cheerleader's appearance. Use the mouse to try the available items and assemble the finished look.

pages.title: King Bird Tower Defense
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description:
Build defenses against incoming enemy waves in King Bird Tower Defense. Spend coins to place towers at building sites along the attackers' route, using the different tower options to defend your base. Defeated enemies provide more coins for further construction.

Towers can be upgraded or sold, letting you revise the setup as the waves continue. Watch the remaining base life and wave display while deciding where the next investment will help, then progress through the game's levels.

pages.title: Princy Throat Doctor
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Help Princy through a hospital visit in Princy Throat Doctor. Carry out the game's throat-treatment and surgery activities, then move to the outfit choices for her post-treatment makeover. Use the mouse to interact with the medical-simulation tasks and the dress-up options as the story moves from care to styling.

pages.title: Jungle Hidden Animals
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Search jungle scenes for concealed cartoon animals in Jungle Hidden Animals. Use the mouse to select the creatures you spot before the time limit expires. The game offers multiple levels and tracks your score as you work through the searches. Scan the scene for animal shapes and details while watching the remaining time.

pages.title: EG Eatable Numbers
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Compare numbers before making contact in EG Eatable Numbers. Guide the numbered object toward targets with smaller values to earn points, keeping it away from those with larger numbers. Use mouse clicks or touch controls to handle the action. The pace increases as you continue, leaving less time to judge which nearby number is a suitable target.

pages.title: Mysticons Choko Say
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: React to animated memes in Mysticons Choko Say. Browse the GIFs and give each a like or dislike according to whether you find it funny or relatable. A vote counter displays how other viewers have responded, letting you compare your reaction with theirs.

pages.title: Little Car Jigsaw
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Rebuild small-car pictures in Little Car Jigsaw. Select one of three images and choose a puzzle size of 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces. Put the pieces together to restore the complete picture, aiming to finish quickly. The four piece counts let you change the difficulty while returning to the same car illustration.

pages.title: Pixel Speed Ball
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Guide a ball along a hazardous course in Pixel Speed Ball. The path is filled with obstacles that you need to avoid as you control the ball's progress.

pages.title: Penguin Fish Run
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Race as a penguin on a treadmill in Penguin Fish Run. Play alone or compete with a friend, keeping your small runner clear of the obstacles coming along the belt.

pages.title: Kendama Contest
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Design the equipment for a princess's first competition in Kendama Contest. Every contestant needs a personalized kendama, so help her create three different types and practice for the event. The preparations combine toy decoration with getting her ready to take part in the contest.

pages.title: Fire And Water Geometry Dash
pages.creator: Bofer Media (Twim Studio)
pages.description: Change between elemental forms to survive the route in Fire And Water Geometry Dash. While in fire form, keep clear of water; after changing into water, avoid fire instead. Switch forms to handle the hazards ahead and stay away from the obstacles that can destroy your character.

pages.title: IRO: Puzzle Game
pages.creator: Minijuegos.com
pages.description: Place colored bands on a compact board in IRO: Puzzle Game. The three-by-three grid contains tiles with three slots each, giving you several positions for arranging colors. Match at least three slots of one color along rows or columns to remove them and earn points. Completing a full row adds combo points, helping you work toward a three-star result for the level.

pages.title: Asteroid Burst
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description:
Fly among roaming asteroids and blast their groups in Asteroid Burst. Fire bombs to break the asteroids apart while steering your spaceship away from collisions. The challenge combines moving through the surrounding space with lining up shots at the formations.

Use W to move forward, S to stop, and the mouse to look around. Left-click fires, while Space switches colors. Keep watching the nearby asteroids so an incoming rock does not destroy the ship while you aim.

pages.title: Hungry Bird World
pages.creator: Ixel Games
pages.description: Dive for fish while avoiding a predator in Hungry Bird World. The bird flies over the sea, and touching the screen launches it into the water to catch fish. Watch the hungry shark as you choose when to dive. Try to increase your catch and improve the fishing record without putting the bird in the shark's path.

pages.title: Chromatic Seals
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Match colored seals with ice of the same color in Chromatic Seals. Drag a cutting line across the ice to split it, letting the pieces fall or slide toward the animals. Contact with matching ice turns a seal gray. Turn every seal gray to complete the puzzle, keeping the animals from falling out of the playfield as you plan the cuts around the layout.

pages.title: Mahjong Jong
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Clear matching tiles against the clock in Mahjong Jong. Use the mouse or tap controls to select identical pairs in the Chinese-themed layout. Each level must be completed within its time limit, so keep looking for the next available match as the board opens up.

pages.title: Creepy Basement Escape Episode 1
pages.creator: Snapbreak Games AB
pages.description: Search a locked room for a way out in Creepy Basement Escape Episode 1. Select objects around the basement to investigate the scene and collect useful items in an inventory. The puzzles include finding keys and using them with locks as you work toward escaping. Compare the objects you have found with the remaining obstacles to decide what to try next.

pages.title: Royal Personal Tailor
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Help a princess prepare for a royal party in Royal Personal Tailor. Find the items needed for the tailoring task, then choose an outfit that suits her style. Add accessories to complete the party look. The activity combines locating the necessary things with deciding how the princess should dress for the occasion.

pages.title: Sweet Angie Fashion Dressing Room!
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Choose makeup and clothes in Sweet Angie Fashion Dressing Room! Angie has new clothing to try for her New Year makeover, and you decide how to combine it with cosmetics. Browse the dressing room's choices and put together her finished appearance, matching the makeup with the outfit you pick.

pages.title: BFFs Dressing Room
pages.creator: DariaGames.com
pages.description: Style two friends from their shared wardrobe in BFFs Dressing Room. Choose a dress for each girl, then match it with shoes, a purse, and accessories. Try the different clothing combinations before settling on the two finished looks. Both friends need help deciding what to wear, so you get to coordinate a separate outfit for each one.

pages.title: Dede Burger Fun
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Build a burger meal to your taste in Dede Burger Fun. Click the category buttons to cycle through different buns, patties, lettuce, tomato, onion, and cheese choices. Change the visible layers until you have the combination you want, then choose details such as the plate, drink, and side dish. The activity focuses on customizing the burger and its presentation alongside Princess Dede.
